name: comp-24
title: Clearable Text Input
blurb: Text input that shows a clear button when text is present.
description: A text input with a conditionally rendered CircleXIcon button that clears the field and refocuses the input. State is managed with useState and useRef.
use_when: Forms where users frequently need to reset fields or delete accidental input.
avoid_when: Required fields that should not be clearable or the input is read-only.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label. Icon marked aria-hidden. Button hidden when input is empty.
